facts.label: Swiss floor plans answered exactly from the CAD file
facts.scope: Every English counting and area question on the 1040 Swiss Dwellings floor plans in the dataset
facts.method: DXF layers read with ezdxf and shapely; counts and areas computed in code, no model
facts.caveat: Each question also has a German, French or Italian twin asking the same fact; only the English lines were scored. Areas count as correct within 2 %, as in the dataset.

facts.label: Library drawings: answers matching the dataset
facts.scope: The 12 seeded library drawings (random.Random(46639) over plans with at least 30 questions)
facts.method: Same solver as the full-set run, answers compared with the dataset gold

facts.label: IFC building models answered from the model file
facts.scope: Every English question on the 29 IFC models in the dataset (counts, room and storey areas, wall lengths and volumes)
facts.method: IfcOpenShell quantities and geometry, computed in code, no model
facts.caveat: Two rules were added after inspecting the misses on this same set; with the original rules the result is 1,691/1,699 (99.5 %).

facts.label: Doors counted exactly on scanned plans (model estimate)
facts.scope: 30 held-out CubiCasa5k plans, 10 per drawing style
facts.method: One Gemini detection call per image; count = boxes returned
facts.caveat: Wilson 95 % interval 42–75 %; within ±1: 25/30; 48.6 % when reweighted to the dataset's style mix.

facts.label: Windows counted exactly on scanned plans (model estimate)
facts.scope: 30 held-out CubiCasa5k plans, 10 per drawing style
facts.method: One Gemini detection call per image; count = boxes returned
facts.caveat: Wilson 95 % interval 39–73 %; within ±1: 23/30; 44.0 % when reweighted to the dataset's style mix.

facts.label: Room and fixture counts right when the model is confident
facts.scope: 115 room and fixture questions on 15 held-out CubiCasa5k plans
facts.method: Gemini Decisions score per family; answer only at confidence 0.6 or higher
facts.caveat: Answers 74 of 115 (64 %); the rest say 'not sure'.
